scope: Floating quick-contact component as observed on page264. Diagnostic only; no WordPress write and no authorization for a global header/dock change.

browser_evidence.source: At 1640x920 the source dock visibly contains phone icon, e-mail icon and green Felmérést kérek CTA.
browser_evidence.target: Repeated same-browser target captures showed a nearly blank white pill while AX still exposed the expected quick-contact region and three links.
browser_evidence.conclusion: Markup/accessibility content exists; the failure is paint/layout/cascade or timing, not missing content.

header_live_source_v001.finding: Exact file read through its full 1-760 line range contains header/nav/mobile-drawer rules but no .dock, .dock__icon, .dock__cta or .af-source-dock rule. Therefore the previous statement that this artifact mapped the dock is stale/incorrect.

header_source_flex_v007.finding: Header/nav/caret/current-state/hamburger responsive rules only; no quick-contact dock styling.

header_runtime_v008.finding: Explicitly protects quick-contact dock content from the header package; does not establish the dock CSS owner.

corrected_provenance.current_conclusion: The actual live dock CSS owner may be another portion of the large central af-project Additional CSS block, runtime-emitted styling or a later rule not preserved as a standalone build artifact. It must be discovered from fresh live post8/DOM evidence before any fix.

page264_scope_rule.possible_local_exception: Only if fresh live cascade proof identifies exact losing declarations and the visual correction can be expressed entirely below body.page-id-264 without editing ID7/global header/footer/shared dock behavior.
page264_scope_rule.otherwise: Record as global owner/out-of-scope for this package; do not change it.

required_live_owner_discovery: Verify target is page264 and read current rendered dock wrapper/child classes and computed display/size/overflow/opacity/visibility/position/transform/color/background values.
Read current Code Snippets ID7 only to learn emitted dock markup/classes/ownership; do not edit from this page264 package.
Search current Hello Additional CSS post8 server-side for exact rendered dock wrapper class plus .dock/.dock__icon/.dock__cta/.af-source-dock fragments; return small snippets only.

For every matching declaration, record source order and whether !important is present for display/flex/width/min/max/height/overflow/opacity/visibility/position/inset/transform/z-index/color/background/flex-shrink/flex-grow.
Measure child bounding boxes. If children are present but 0-sized/clipped, identify the first ancestor whose computed box/overflow creates the loss.
Check timing by two screenshots after stable load before assuming a deterministic cascade failure.

decision_tree.global_owner_only: No write from page264. Preserve the defect as an explicit global-scope blocker.
decision_tree.page264_specific_losing_rule_proven: Prepare the smallest body.page-id-264-scoped property override; do not recreate markup and do not edit ID7.
decision_tree.timing_or_transient_paint: Do not force CSS. Diagnose load/runtime timing with stable repeated captures.
decision_tree.markup_missing_live: Stop and reconcile against historical AX evidence; do not rebuild from memory.

future_page264_override_gate_if_applicab: Every effect selector starts with body.page-id-264 and targets the exact live dock class hierarchy.
Header/nav/footer/forms/page content stay outside effect selectors.
Fresh post8 marker/hash preflight and mandatory readback.
Source/target screenshot plus AX regression check after write.
If any non-page264 page would change, reject the override and leave the issue to the global header/dock workstream.
